runs.name: Arcadis N.V.; Euronext Amsterdam ARCAD, US OTC ADR ARCAY, SEC CIK 0000913596, a Form 15-12G of 2008-06-09 and no annual report with the SEC since; design, engineering and consultancy in Resilience, Places, Mobility and Intelligence, the last dissolved into the others from 2026; IBI Group 2022, KUA Group and WSP German rail engineering 2025, SATEL signed and not closed; AECOM, Jacobs and Stantec read from the report's named peer group
runs.entry: Price **EUR 41.20** a share (Euronext Amsterdam close 2026-10-16, `tools/sources.py`; aggregator, flagged; the ADR at USD 44.81 not priced, its ratio unconfirmed from the depositary). Shares **85,205,601** ordinary outstanding at 2026-06-30 (H1 2026 interim financial statements, note 17: 90,442,691 issued less 5,236,490 treasury; 86,128,168 at 2025-12-31, AR2025 p.238; 600 priority shares carry control, not economics). Sovereign **3.67%** (ECB euro area 30-year, YC.B.U2.EUR.4F.G_N_A.SV_C_YM.SR_30Y, 2026-10-15; the euro is the reporting currency; about two thirds of net revenue is earned outside the euro area, the US 30-year 5.43% recorded beside). A name with no SEC filings: documents read are the Annual Integrated Report 2025 (authorized 2026-02-18), the H1 2026 interim statements and press release of 2026-07-30, and the annual reports 2016 to 2021, 2023 and 2024 (2022 from the 2023 comparatives); document and PDF page in place of an accession number; `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` returned nothing, all arithmetic by hand from the filed statements. The brief's stated departures: lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the report's equivalents of Items 1, 1A and 7 (business and Global Business Area chapters, the risk-management chapter, whose principal-risks table is an image and was not read, the financial review, segment note and five-year summary), and the competitors the report names (AECOM, Jacobs and Stantec read; WSP, AtkinsRéalis, Sweco, AFRY, Fugro, Worley, Spie and Alten flagged as not SEC filers; Tetra Tech and NV5 not read under the limit of three). **Q1 IN**: fees for its own staff's time, 9,000+ clients, 95% repeat revenue, the fixed-price element the auditor's key matter; M1997-114 on firms of "armies of engineers" recorded against. **Q2 OUT**: the deciding part Resilience, 44% of four-year segment operating EBITA (51% on segment operating income); the castle shown open: share bought with money by named rivals and by Arcadis itself (Stantec C$702M, C$555M and C$454M of purchases in 2021, 2024 and 2025; AECOM USD 213M in FY2025; WSP selling Arcadis its German rail engineering; Arcadis's IBI Group, EUR 799.6M cash, 2022), the filer's own "increasingly commoditized" market, ten-year means of operating margin 5.0% against AECOM 4.0%, Jacobs 4.8% and Stantec 5.8% pre-tax and return on equity 9.9% against 6.4%, 9.2% and 9.6%, all moving together; wage inflation passed through by the whole field; Places margin 10.2% to 7.9% in the one year of falling volume (2025); the high return on tangible capital (M2011-060) carried as a weighing for Q3, not a castle, as every rival earns it. Q3 to Q12 not reached. **COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE**: owner cash 2021 to 2025 EUR 225.8M, 168.7M, 182.8M, 219.0M, 260.0M (2025 less the filer's own EUR 19M factoring figure), mean EUR 211.3M equity basis, EUR 231.6M all-equity, after leases and stock pay; net purchases EUR 884.6M against owner cash before purchases of EUR 1,157.8M, a serial acquirer, central case the organic pair at the filer's reported organic growth of 5.40% a year (default pair EUR 47.39 to EUR 92.73 beside); net debt EUR 813M at 2026-06-30, leases left out; value range **EUR 64.52 to EUR 107.66** a share all-equity against EUR 41.20, no case earns the floor (5.36% to 7.96% all-equity, 6.02% to 8.84% equity-only); fair **EUR 23.74 all-equity** (EUR 30.37 equity-only); not armed, the box is OUT at Q2. Balance sheets 2016 to mid-2026: goodwill and intangibles above equity in eight of ten year ends, equity EUR 1,002M to EUR 1,033M against about EUR 1,050M of cumulative net income (dividends, buybacks, translation losses, write-offs for the Middle East, CallisonRTKL and the ALEN associate in Brazil), working capital from about a quarter to about a seventh of gross revenue, net cash in 2021 to net debt EUR 813M. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: operating EBITA excluding EUR 77M of 2025 non-operating costs with restructuring every year, an Operating EBITDA margin target from 2027 (M1998-086 cited), annual guidance (L2019-006 cited), year-end factoring, the 2020 IAS 8 restatement, two figures for 2023 free cash flow, a new chief executive from 2026-03-01, buybacks at EUR 27.58 to EUR 66.16 with no price cap, priority-share and protective-preference control devices, the employee foundation holding about a fifth of the shares. Contamination declared by the analyst: the ARCB and AYI research-folder names in git status, the KBR commit subjects and one memory index line naming no company; the only `Test Runs/` listing was a filename filter for the name, which returned nothing; none used. Commits 4cbb1228 (template), 44fd0ee9 (Step 0 and Q1), 636d3c67 (Q2), 99593cb6 (computation, box, close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `scripts/check_ids.py` 35 distinct ids and 35 fragments, PASS; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 35 ids, no missing id, no E-id, four flags each verified as the checker reaching across a heading or a neighbouring id's quote (M1995-040, L2004-007, M1999-130, M2000-014 all hold the words beside them): **no slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) Q2's ordinary returns names no capital base, tangible capital against equity that is mostly goodwill; (2) no rule for the sovereign of a euro reporter earning two thirds of its revenue in other currencies; (3) net debt at a seasonal half-year date (EUR 3.02 a share here); (4) the range at the sovereign and the floor at ten percent pull apart, and Q6's buyback test reads against the range; (5) the serial-acquirer convention firing on one large deal; (6) the parts table names no profit measure and met a segment structure that changed twice; (7) a principal-risks section published only as an image. Could not get: the principal-risks table, the 2022 report, the ADR ratio, the SATEL price, the rivals' figures beyond XBRL transcription.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 after Q1 IN (Arcadis N.V.; Euronext ARCAD, OTC ADR ARCAY; design, engineering and consultancy in Resilience, Places, Mobility and Intelligence; no SEC filings since 2008, read from its own annual reports). The castle of the deciding part, Resilience at 44% of four-year segment operating EBITA, shown open: share bought with money by named rivals and by Arcadis itself (Stantec's purchases, AECOM's, WSP's German rail sale to Arcadis, Arcadis's EUR 799.6M IBI Group), the filer's own "increasingly commoditized" market, ten-year margins and returns on equity of Arcadis, AECOM, Jacobs and Stantec in one band and co-moving. Computation beneath the stop: value EUR 64.52 to EUR 107.66 all-equity at the 3.67% euro rate against EUR 41.20, no case earns the floor (best 7.96%), fair EUR 23.74 (EUR 30.37 equity-only), not armed. Facts recorded, not judged: goodwill above equity in eight of ten years, EUR 77M of 2025 costs outside operating EBITA, an EBITDA margin target from 2027, annual guidance, year-end factoring, a new chief executive from March 2026. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: the capital base of ordinary returns, the sovereign of a multi-currency earner, a seasonal half-year net debt, the range and the floor pulling apart, the serial-acquirer rule on one deal, the parts table's profit measure, a risks table published as an image.
